items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section I, List of Answers on Terminology 53:1
items.html: One who receives inside himself is discerned as having the light measured and bounded in the vessel; and one who receives outside himself is discerned as placing no boundary at all upon the light that he receives. (Part 1, Chapter 1, Inner Light, Item 50)
